title: Prepare Project Atlas beta launch with 5 pilot shippers
body:
Coordinate the closed beta of **Project Atlas** with five pilot shippers before general availability.

**Checklist**

* Confirm pilot shipper list and contacts with Joe Smith (account management)
* Enable the Atlas feature flag for pilot accounts only
* Schedule 30-minute onboarding calls with each pilot shipper
* Set up a shared feedback channel and a weekly check-in
* Define success metrics: weekly active users, reduction in "where's my truck" calls, ETA accuracy

**Target beta start:** two weeks after the tracking map and ETA model reach staging.
author: Abraham AIProject
